##### Project general facts

Binghatti Vintage is a contemporary residential tower located in Majan, defined by its distinctive architectural identity and signature illuminated façade. The building combines bold geometry with refined detailing, creating a strong visual presence while maintaining a sense of modern elegance. Designed with efficiency and comfort in mind, the project offers a collection of studios, as well as one- and two-bedroom apartments, featuring fluid layouts, expansive windows, and an emphasis on natural light, resulting in a bright and balanced living environment.

Residents benefit from a wide range of amenities designed to enhance both lifestyle and well-being. The development includes multiple swimming pools, yoga zones, landscaped gardens, and an outdoor cinema, creating spaces for relaxation, recreation, and social interaction. Its location near green areas and key leisure destinations further enriches the residential experience, offering a harmonious balance between urban convenience and a calm, community-oriented atmosphere.

Interiors are finished with a premium palette of materials, including travertine stone, walnut, accent marble, brass, and metallic glass, complemented by soft neutral tones that create a warm and sophisticated ambiance. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, ensuring practicality for everyday living. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from high-quality finishes and a refined design foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district located in the heart of the expansive Dubailand community. It is an ideal choice for those seeking buy-to-invest opportunities. As the area continues to develop, property prices remain below their peak levels, offering investors the advantage of purchasing off-plan units with attractive discounts.

Situated along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and close to Al Ain Road, Majan enjoys strategic connectivity to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi. The district features 100 residential complexes, six landmark towers, four hotels, and several mixed-use developments.

One of Majan’s main advantages is its proximity to top-rated schools, business and shopping centers, healthcare institutions, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. Despite its prime location and well-developed infrastructure, rental prices remain lower than in Dubai’s coastal or central districts. This makes Majan a popular choice among both residents and tourists looking for quality housing at affordable rates.The interiors of Binghatti Vintage are crafted with intentional richness, showcasing a refined material palette of travertine stone, walnut, accent marble, brass, metallic glass, and light petal tones. The tactile textures and warm neutral hues create a serene, high-end atmosphere that balances modern luxury with timeless design. Each residence embodies comfort and depth, ensuring a sophisticated living experience for discerning homeowners.
